title: October 18th First Call
speaker: Chris Vecchio and Ilya Spivak

macro_themes.view: CoreWeave bonds >15% yield, data-center cancellations and financing strain may be the first cockroach of an AI distribution event, though it's early (like 2007 or 1999).
Bonds rallying while oil surges and CPI/PPI run hot signals the market is pricing a growth scare, possibly shallow like July.
Both the war trade and the AI trade are inflation stories, so markets hinge on how much inflation the economy can swallow and the Fed.
Outside crises a 6% 10-day drop is usually followed by gains (avg +5.9% at 3 months); continuation lower from here would suggest a crisis path.

calls.condition: If this is a non-crisis episode and the mid-September low pivot holds, the selloff was the flush; a further leg lower implies a crisis path and deeper selloff.
calls.reason: Historical study since 1986: after a 6% drop from a 10-day high, Nasdaq averages +0.68% at 1 week, +1.99% at 1 month, +5.9% at 3 months (non-crisis); price sits at the September pivot.
calls.quote: it does stand to reason then maybe this what we just experienced in recent sessions was the flush. We just live through it.

calls.condition: Long against the range bottom; works if gold is building a shallow series of higher lows as yields break down.
calls.reason: Range bottom held similar to July's low; falling yields and breakevens not following oil suggest growth-scare backdrop supportive of gold.
calls.quote: long against basically this range bottom just to see, okay, like maybe what we're developing is a shallow series of higher lows.

calls.reason: Bonds rallying (yields falling) despite hot CPI/PPI and surging oil, implying markets price a growth scare; bonds gapped higher at the open.
calls.quote: if yields are breaking down and maybe gold's going to try to turn the corner again here.

calls.condition: Needs Micron to get back above ~910 for a week or two for his defined-risk call spreads to pay.
calls.reason: Holds defined-risk out-of-the-money call spreads on memory names after a horrific week; still believes the long-term AI story.
calls.quote: I do need micro trying to get back above maybe like 910 for like a week or two.

notes: Recorded at Sunday evening futures open (Oct 18). TYX entry is weak: bonds price (105'13 on ZB, shown as 105.13) and bias is on yields (bearish = bonds up); speakers mostly describe the move rather than forecast it. MU '910' level taken from transcript as said (possibly garbled); ownership of the call spreads attributed to Chris. Ilya's silver short was closed; no current silver view recorded.
